summary: Iter 36 (report file iteration_34.json — next after iter33) — Verified fix for 'non-floor-plan blueprints not traced' bug. 5/5 backend pytest cases pass. Confirmed: (1) opencv_tracer.trace_walls_from_image produces walls on synthetic raster; (2) documents.py DRAWING_TYPES set now includes framing_plan/roof_plan/sheathing_plan/elevation/electrical_plan/plumbing_plan/hvac_plan/detail so OpenCV branch runs for all drawing view types (verified via source-code introspection); (3) full E2E — uploading a framing-like PNG classifies via GPT-4o, pipeline completes to status='done', a blueprint_sheet is created with view_type set, walls array populated, and at least one wall has source='opencv'; (4) REF_ONLY view types (framing_plan/roof_plan/etc.) land with floor_level=-99 so the 3D renderer will not extrude them as building stories; (5) GET /api/projects/{id}/blueprint/sheets returns non-floor-plan sheets with `walls` intact so the CAD tab can render geometry; (6) regression floor-plan upload still works and stacks (floor_level != -99).
critical_code_review_comments: documents.py:547 DRAWING_TYPES set is correctly expanded to cover all drawing view types; OpenCV branch now runs regardless of whether view_type is 'floor_plan'.

documents.py:651 is_reference_only set correctly marks REF_ONLY view types (framing/roof/sheathing/mep/elevation/detail) — floor_level=-99 acts as the flag consumed by frontend sceneBuilder.js REF_ONLY filter to skip 3D extrusion. Two-layer guard is sound: backend flags via floor_level+view_type; frontend enforces the 3D-stacking skip.
opencv_tracer.py cleanly separates AI-provided building_ft from auto-scale fallback; auto-scale assumes long_side_ft=60 which is a rough heuristic — flag but not a bug.
documents.py OpenCV walls are stamped with source='opencv' allowing frontend to distinguish AI vs OpenCV-traced walls for styling/debugging. Good observability.
No _id leaks in sheet responses (verified in test_sheet_listing_returns_non_floor_plan_with_walls).
seed_data_creation: One ephemeral user + auto-created default project per test module. Two document uploads (framing-like + floor-plan-like PNGs) go through the full AI+OpenCV pipeline.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix is fully verified. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter36_all_drawing_types_traced.py exercises both unit (opencv_tracer + DRAWING_TYPES membership) and full E2E (upload → GPT-4o classify → OpenCV trace → sheet created with source='opencv' walls). To rerun: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_iter36_all_drawing_types_traced.py -v` (BASE_URL is not read from .env because tests hit external ingress). Runtime ~16s total. NOTE: test_framing_like_upload_populates_walls_via_opencv has a conditional guard — if GPT-4o classifies the synthetic image as 'photo' or 'other' (outside DRAWING_TYPES) it prints a note but still passes; in current run all classifications fell inside DRAWING_TYPES so the OpenCV-source-wall assertion did fire.
rca of the issue: Original bug: user's steel framing plan (framing_plan view_type) was showing raw underlay image but no traced vector lines because the pipeline gated OpenCV wall extraction on view_type=='floor_plan'. Fix (already applied by main agent): (a) documents.py DRAWING_TYPES set now includes framing_plan/roof_plan/sheathing_plan/elevation/mep/detail so `if doc_type in DRAWING_TYPES` succeeds and both GPT-4o wall list AND OpenCV Hough-line trace get merged into walls_all; (b) OpenCV walls are stamped with source='opencv' for observability; (c) REF_ONLY sheets still get created (so CAD tab shows underlay + traced lines) but with floor_level=-99; (d) frontend sceneBuilder.js REF_ONLY set filters those out of 3D extrusion so they don't stack as floors. Both backend and integration verified.
